solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One denies detective worked miracles

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector

indicators.note: worked as in kneaded or reshaped, so the letters of miracles are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sceptic's line: a detective has been performing miracles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worked' reads as performed, but signals the anagram that makes SCLAIMER.
explanation.definitionFit: A disclaimer is a statement of denial, so it is literally something that denies.

clue.text: Light control key originally tested in E Anglian town

parts.note: D is a musical key

indicators.note: in says the first letter goes inside the town

parts.note: Ipswich is the county town of Suffolk in East Anglia

indicators.note: originally points to the start of tested

explanation.surface: A light switch tested in a town in East Anglia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' gives T, placed inside IPSWICH, the Suffolk county town.
explanation.definitionFit: A switch on car headlamps that lowers the beam to avoid dazzling oncoming drivers.

clue.text: Exclusive duck's off — everyone's eaten shellfish

indicators.note: eaten means the reduced word swallows the next piece
off means the duck is removed

parts.note: a scoop is a newspaper exclusive
in cricket a duck is a score of zero, O
everyone is all

explanation.surface: An exclusive dish of duck is off the menu, so everyone ate seafood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'duck' is the cricket zero, not the bird; 'off' leaves SCOP and 'eaten' takes in the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A scallop is a bivalve mollusc with a fan-shaped shell.

clue.text: Fine briefly raised with leading European

indicators.note: leading puts this piece in front

parts.note: and means with

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means read upwards, backwards
briefly cuts off the last letter

parts.note: fine means thin or narrow

explanation.surface: A fine was cut and raised, alongside a leading European figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fine' means thin, not a penalty; 'briefly' trims it, and 'raised' turns NARRO upwards to ORRAN, which 'leading' puts after its partner.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Andorra, the small principality in the Pyrenees.

clue.text: 'Blasted feminists are OTT' — government official

indicators.note: blasted as in blown apart, so the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A minister damns feminists as over the top.
explanation.walkthrough: OTT is British slang for 'over the top', excessive.
explanation.definitionFit: A junior UK government minister ranking below a Secretary of State.

clue.text: Fragments from books written in code

indicators.note: written in means put inside

parts.note: a rule is a code of conduct
B is short for book, doubled for plural

explanation.surface: Fragmentary books written in secret code.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubble is broken pieces of stone or brick.

clue.text: Block, playing back what are bowled short of a length

indicators.note: playing back, like a tape run in reverse, means the letters are read from the end
short of says the following item is missing from what precedes it

parts.note: in cricket the bowler delivers balls
L is the abbreviation for length

explanation.surface: A cricket batter blocks, playing back to deliveries pitched short of a good length.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short of' removes L from BALLS, giving BALS; 'playing back' reverses it. A batter 'plays back' by stepping towards the stumps.
explanation.definitionFit: A slab is a thick flat block of stone, concrete or similar material.

clue.text: Long walk to go through for the first time

definitions.text: go through for the first time

parts.note: to long is to sigh for
to tread is to walk

explanation.surface: A long walk to complete for the first time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long' looks like an adjective but is the verb, sigh.
explanation.definitionFit: Musicians sight-read when performing a piece unseen, at first sight.

clue.text: Recall artist turning up in a band

parts.note: to recall a decision is to annul it

indicators.note: turning up in a down clue reads upwards, reversing

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: An artist recalled to play in a band.
explanation.definitionFit: Annular means ring-shaped, formed as a circular band.

clue.text: Gradually introduced new heads to secure housing

indicators.note: housing means the first piece encloses the second

parts.note: to pin something is to secure it

indicators.note: new signals a fresh arrangement of the letters of heads

explanation.surface: Fresh department heads were brought in to safeguard housing policy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'housing' looks like a policy area but is the containment signal; 'new' makes HASED.
explanation.definitionFit: Something phased in is brought in by stages, gradually rather than all at once.

clue.text: Epic finale essential to Chitty Chitty Bang Bang?

definitions.text: essential to Chitty Chitty Bang Bang?

parts.note: an epic production is big
a finale is the end

explanation.surface: A film review: the spectacular ending is what makes Chitty Chitty Bang Bang.
explanation.walkthrough: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang is a children's film about a flying car; a big end is a bearing in a car engine.
explanation.definitionFit: A big end is the crankshaft bearing of a connecting rod, a vital part of any car engine.

clue.text: When skipping I exercise joint

indicators.note: skipping means leaving out the letter that follows

parts.note: to wield power is to exercise it

explanation.surface: Someone avoids exercising when skipping rope hurts a joint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skipping' looks like the rope exercise but means omitting I from WIELD.
explanation.definitionFit: A weld is a joint made by fusing two pieces of metal.

clue.text: Chemical used to break into bank, without a doubt

indicators.note: used to break into means the chemical is placed inside the other word

parts.note: to bank on something is to rely on it
a solute is a chemical dissolved in a solution

explanation.surface: Safebreakers used chemicals to get into a bank, beyond any doubt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' is the verb, as in 'bank on', not a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something resolutely means doing it with firm determination, unwavering and without hesitation.

clue.text: The very best prizes (two) kept back

indicators.note: kept back means the pieces are written backwards

parts.note: two prizes: a reward and a pot (a trophy)

explanation.surface: Two prizes of the very best quality are being withheld.
explanation.walkthrough: The two prizes, REWARD and POT, are written backwards as one string.
explanation.definitionFit: Top-drawer is an idiom for the highest social rank or quality, the finest.

clue.text: In ten years' time, he won't show depravity

parts.note: a decade is ten years

indicators.note: won't show says the word fails to appear

parts.note: hence means in time from now

explanation.surface: In ten years he won't show such depravity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In ... time' is DECADE HENCE; 'won't show' drops HE.
explanation.definitionFit: Decadence is moral decline and self-indulgence, a form of corruption.

clue.text: Alignment of feet determines such a distance

definitions.meaning: in verse, the arrangement of stressed and unstressed syllables in feet
a unit of length, a hundred centimetres

explanation.surface: How you line up your feet decides how far you can go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feet' here are units of verse, not body parts; 'determines' just joins the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Poetic rhythm made of feet, and also the metric unit of length.

clue.text: In SE, mounted talks to dismiss posh governor's wife

indicators.note: the clue opens 'In SE', so the trimmed talks are set inside those two letters
mounted in a down clue means climbing upwards, so the letters are read from the bottom
to dismiss means remove the piece

parts.note: lectures are talks
U means upper-class, posh

explanation.surface: In the South East, an official's wife gave talks and dismissed posh people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounted' looks like staged, but in a down clue it reverses SE to ES; 'to dismiss' makes LECTRES. 'governor' is an Elector of the Holy Roman Empire.
explanation.definitionFit: Wife of an Elector, a prince who chose the Holy Roman Emperor.

clue.text: On the coast it's hard to remove salt in mere

definitions.text: On the coast it's hard to remove

indicators.note: in places one piece inside another

parts.note: bare means mere, as in bare minimum
NaCl is the chemical formula for common salt

explanation.surface: Salt is hard to remove from a lake on the coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mere' is an adjective, not a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A barnacle clings so tightly to coastal rocks and hulls that prising it off is hard.

clue.text: Come to church to find something uplifting

parts.note: to hit on or come to a figure means to reach it

explanation.surface: Going to church to find something spiritually uplifting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uplifting' is taken literally: a hitch is a ride you thumb, a lift.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitch, informally, is a free ride got by hitchhiking, so it gives the traveller a lift.

clue.text: Battleground has James in a state, turning over inside

indicators.note: in puts James inside the state
turning over inside says the inner letters of the state swap places

parts.note: Iowa is a US state
Jim is short for James

explanation.surface: A battlefield where James is upset in a state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning over inside' swaps only the two middle letters of the state, giving IWOA, before 'in' adds James.
explanation.definitionFit: Iwo Jima was the site of a major 1945 battle between US and Japanese forces.

clue.text: Quality of chicken cubes added to company strife

indicators.note: added to puts the cubes after the company strife

parts.note: war is strife
dice are cubes

explanation.surface: Diced chicken is added to a company's food fight, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chicken' means a coward, not the meat that 'cubes' suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: Being chicken means being afraid, and the trait of the fearful is lack of courage.

clue.text: Sage's wife missing after couple set out separately

indicators.note: after puts the reduced word after the couple

parts.note: an item is a couple in a relationship

indicators.note: missing says the wife is removed

parts.note: wise means sage

explanation.surface: A wise man's wife leaves after the couple separate.
explanation.definitionFit: To itemise is to list things individually, one by one.

clue.text: Roar coming from lower down, with twice the heart

indicators.note: with twice the heart says the central letter appears doubled

parts.note: below means lower down

explanation.surface: A roar coming from lower down, with a doubled heartbeat.
explanation.walkthrough: The heart of BELOW is L; doubling it gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To bellow is to shout loudly, like a bull.

clue.text: Figure heading column left Londoners stunned

indicators.note: stunned, as in knocked senseless, says the letters of Londoners are jumbled

explanation.surface: Londoners were stunned when the figure atop the column was removed.
explanation.walkthrough: The statue of the admiral stands on Nelson's Column in Trafalgar Square, London.
explanation.definitionFit: The admiral's statue stands at the top of the famous column in Trafalgar Square.

clue.text: Express coming, with no announcement

indicators.note: with no says the following piece is dropped

parts.note: an advent is a coming or arrival
AD is short for advertisement, an announcement

explanation.surface: An express train arrives without any announcement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Express' is the verb, to give vent to feelings, not a train.
explanation.definitionFit: To vent a feeling is to voice or release it openly.

clue.text: Remarkable gesture

definitions.meaning: a sign or movement made to communicate

explanation.surface: A remarkable gesture.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means conspicuous; as a noun, a sign made to convey a message.

clue.text: 'Get up, having drunk tea' put in old words

indicators.note: having drunk means the first piece swallows the second

parts.note: to arise is to get up
cha is slang for tea

explanation.surface: Someone told to get up after a cup of tea, phrased quaintly.
explanation.definitionFit: To archaise is to render something in an antiquated style, using obsolete vocabulary.

clue.text: Recited ballads don't do much

indicators.note: recited means spoken out, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: lays are ballads or narrative songs

explanation.surface: Reciting ballads hardly counts as doing anything.
explanation.definitionFit: To loaf about idly, relaxing and doing little.

clue.text: Those not finishing strongly, it's said, who won't be here for long?

definitions.text: who won't be here for long?

indicators.note: it's said marks a sound-alike of the preceding words

parts.note: those with a weak ending, weak-enders

explanation.surface: Runners who fade at the finish won't be around long.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a cryptic hint: weekend visitors stay only a couple of days.
explanation.definitionFit: Short-stay visitors who come for Saturday and Sunday only.
